# Agent Pass

> Let AI agents pay to use any Express app. An agent that calls the app's agent route gets `402 Payment Required`, pays 0.05 USDC on Stellar over MPP, and gets a pass for an hour. No account, no sign-up. The owner adds it with one npm package (`@nicko-ai/agent-pass`) and one sentence in Claude Code, and watches every sale on a dashboard the app serves itself. HackMeridian 2026, Stellar Composed track. Testnet only.

This site is the live demo. It is one Express app with three parts: this landing page, a sample store (Marta Icons) that sells its icon search to agents, and the store owner's sales dashboard.

## How a visit works

1. **402.** The agent calls `/agent/icons?q=sun` with no pass. The gate answers with an MPP charge: the price, the owner's Stellar address, USDC on Stellar testnet.
2. **Pay.** The agent signs a USDC transfer with its own Stellar key and retries. The owner's server sends it to the network and waits until it settles (about five seconds).
3. **Pass.** Only after the money settles, the server records the pass in the shared `agent_pass` Soroban contract and answers with an `Agent-Pass` token signed by the owner's key.
4. **Next calls.** The agent sends the token. The gate checks the signature and expiry locally, with no payment, until the pass expires.

## Set it up

Open Claude Code in an Express app and type:

    Install the @nicko-ai/agent-pass npm package and follow node_modules/@nicko-ai/agent-pass/skills/agent-pass/SKILL.md to sell /agent to AI agents for 0.05 USDC per hour.

Claude Code installs the package, makes or loads the owner's Stellar key in the Stellar CLI, puts the gate on the route, mounts the dashboard on `/agent-pass`, and pays once from a test agent to prove it.

## Live demo

- [Landing page](https://agent-pass-sample.vercel.app/): what Agent Pass is, in one page
- [Marta Icons](https://agent-pass-sample.vercel.app/marta): the sample store, a plain Express app with the gate added; people use it for free
- [Agent door](https://agent-pass-sample.vercel.app/agent/icons?q=sun): the same icon search for agents; answers `402 Payment Required` with the price until an agent pays
- [Owner's dashboard](https://agent-pass-sample.vercel.app/agent-pass): earned, passes sold, agents, balance and every sale, read live from the Stellar testnet ledger; no database

## On-chain proof

- [`agent_pass` contract](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CDLR2ABHIPQ7SNWJKT3S5EE7DFTZ2VB2FJLISODIFNLYCRUCZKBFYJKU): the shared Soroban contract every app writes its passes to
- [A real payment through this site](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/tx/4ba07b25c587a662eb9527b96a86cd1e7eaafb1fce96081fe20a95e524008de1): 0.05 USDC from a test agent to the store's owner
- [Its pass](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/tx/4480e7e7292b8376d5e27688f7c90eec4dacf3fc5ca1e59e3f840ac073bf3a0a): written to the contract by the owner's key

## Code

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/berryxmas/agent-pass): the middleware, the Soroban contract, the sample site, a second app that honors the same pass, and the on-chain proofs
- [npm package @nicko-ai/agent-pass](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nicko-ai/agent-pass): the gate, the dashboard and the Claude Code skill
- [README](https://github.com/berryxmas/agent-pass#readme): the full write-up, why MPP and Stellar, and every transaction hash
